Title: Azure Analysis Services—Two new higher compute SKUs are now available

Body.Content:
Two new SKUs for Azure Analysis Services, S8V2 and S9V2, are now available. These SKUs are based on next-generation hardware and have double the QPU (abstraction of CPU) of the existing S8/S9 SKUs. The new SKUs will eventually replace the S8/S9 SKUs, so we recommend you evaluate the V2 SKUs at your convenience. 

 

See QPU/memory details and current availability by region.

 

See pricing details.
